titles.native: 寺島町奇譚 ぎんながし

description:
Ten-year-old Kyoshi watches as a tramp transforms himself into a rich imposter at a stand-up bar in the Tamanoi district. Amusing tales from pre-war Tokyo based on the 1968 autobiographical manga Strange Tales of Terajima, written by Yuu Takita for the alternative magazine Garo.

(Source: The Anime Encyclopedia, edited)
